pure_readiness: The query shares the unchanged inject_interrupt predicate and performs no target read, vector acknowledgement, frame delivery or service completion. Query before each peripheral acknowledgement; pending blocked sources remain untouched.
legacy: Normal builds and default-off experimental builds retain the original macro body. Existing same-level INT5-before-SCC ordering and accepted-only STOP clearing are preserved.
spurious: A zero vector retains existing clearing of that source flag, then permits selection of a lower eligible source. No acknowledgement is attempted for masked, halted, service-pending or restart-blocked CPU contexts.
limits: Source-object SCC tests require an owned Serial backend and are not native Windows serial input acceptance.
User/master/nested/reassertion, trace/restart, equal-level/spurious/STOP and full platform regressions remain gates before admission.
No native compiler instruction admission, imported integer/restart body, ABI structure, default or RC3 change follows from this experiment.
